title: Guardian Case File "NTOC2024 Possible UAPs [Unidentified Anomalous Phenomena] Hovering Near Rolling Meadows, IL. [Illinois]," January 8, 2025
doc_notes: This document is an FBI Guardian case file regarding a UAP sighting in Rolling Meadows, IL, which was investigated and closed due to a lack of corroborating sensor data from local airports.

incidents.summary: Witness reported seeing three or four glowing orbs hovering in the sky in Rolling Meadows, IL.
incidents.quote: reported seeing three or four glowing orbs hovering in the sky
